name: attest_action
description: Create a host-side signed ACTION attestation (yes/no record that an action happened). Arguments are hashed; PII stays on the host.

arguments.name: action
arguments.desc: Action name or identifier to attest

arguments.name: outcome
arguments.desc: Optional outcome (for example yes or no)

name: verify_action
description: Verify a previously issued AffixIO ACTION attestation or receipt. Returns valid true or false plus reason.

arguments.name: attestation
arguments.desc: Attestation or receipt payload to verify

name: gate_tool_call
description: Decide allow or deny for a privileged agent tool call under local policy, and return a signed decision. Call before privileged tools.

arguments.name: args_hash
arguments.desc: Hash or summary of tool arguments (raw args are not stored)

arguments.name: policy
arguments.desc: Optional policy overrides for this gate
